svg.title: Smart Tutor AI — RAG pipeline
svg.desc: Offline ingestion of INFO 5731 course materials into an S3 vector store, and the online per-message pipeline from the chat UI through retrieval, Bedrock generation, grounding and streaming.
svg.text: Grounded answers from INFO 5731 course materials · AWS Bedrock · S3 vector store · SSE streaming
② Query online · every chat message (POST /chat/sessions/{id}/messages)
only if course context is weak
③ Observability & evaluation every stage is traced
